title: Chapter 2 · Memory tickets on the station tablet
description: Down into the L1 at Fabra i Puig with nothing remembered yet: the network map is a tablet on the station's tiles, and only Trinitat Vella is marked as somewhere to go. Under the map Gerard writes a memory of someone somewhere. Half a memory gets half an answer; Luca at the Sagrada Família prints its ticket and the station lights up. The judge is faked here so the scenario never calls the API. The answer is lit by the verdict's colour: red, nothing; yellow, close; green, the ticket prints.

steps.eval: Promise.all([import('/src/map-markers.ts'), import('/src/tickets.ts')]).then(([m, t]) => { const g = window.gerard; const verdicts = { none: { station: null, person: false, place: false, colour: 'red' }, luca: { station: 'sagrada-familia', person: true, place: false, colour: 'yellow' }, full: { station: 'sagrada-familia', person: true, place: true, colour: 'green' } }; window.ticketMemory = { locked: g.story.lockedStations, remember: text => new Promise(done => setTimeout(() => done(/sagrada/i.test(text) ? verdicts.full : /luca/i.test(text) ? verdicts.luca : verdicts.none), 600)), opened: station => g.storyEvent({ type: 'ticket', station }) }; void g.travelUI.show('fabra-i-puig', {}, m.cityMarkers({ castle: true, threat: .8, spread: .3 }), window.ticketMemory) }) && undefined
